title: เมืองที่เงียบเกินไป (3D psychological horror)
brief: A stylized 3D apocalyptic psychological-horror scene with a third-person observer camera

style.look: stylized low-poly ruins, cold teal fog, one warm practical light, letterbox, slow dread

scenes.shot: Over-the-shoulder observer camera follows a lone survivor down a ruined street in fog
scenes.motion: walk cycle, lagged follow camera, handheld drift, ash

scenes.shot: Survivor stops; camera slowly circles to a low angle; a window light flickers far ahead
scenes.motion: orbit + dolly, flickering practical, breathing idle

scenes.shot: Camera pushes past the survivor: a motionless silhouette at the end of the street, it twitches
scenes.motion: slow push-in, dolly zoom, twitch, light cuts out
scenes.text: มันไม่ได้ตามเรามา

scenes.shot: Reverse: the observer camera itself was being watched, figures behind; title
scenes.motion: whip pan 180°, shake, red light, title reveal
scenes.text: มันอยู่ข้างหลังเรามาตลอด / เมืองที่เงียบเกินไป
